data.caption:
Bathinda se shuru hua desh ka pehla wheelchair cricket tournament! 🏏

• PCA ne diye 20 special wheelchairs
• Khel ke prati jazba dekhne layak
• Desh mein naye sport ki shuruat

Jazbe ko salaam karne ke liye ek like toh banta hai!

Aapke hisaab se sports mein sabse zaroori kya hai? Comment mein batao.
